expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: A circular loading spinner sits in a white circle in the middle of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image. The illustration is already rendered behind it, so the card looks stuck in a loading state or has a leftover overlay. It covers the main subject of the image.

The time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') on the 'Fastest near you' cards overlap the plate image and hang over the bottom-left edge of the image. On the first card the pill covers part of the plate and looks awkwardly placed.

The secondary gray text (delivery fees, the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' line, the search placeholder) is light gray on white or light gray backgrounds and has borderline contrast. The heart icon on the dark image also has a low-contrast translucent background.

The discount badge '−20%' and the heart button on the pizza card use different offsets and treatments than the ramen card. The '€0 delivery' badge is green text on white while the '−20%' badge is styled differently, so the badges look inconsistent.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 describes a loading spinner over already rendered card content.
